infrastructure.name: Custom Dashboards
infrastructure.code:
# Service Health Dashboard

## Widgets

### Request Rate
- Metric: requests.per.second
- Visualization: Timeseries
- Group by: service, endpoint
- Alert threshold: > 10000 requests/sec

### Error Rate
- Metric: errors.per.second / requests.per.second * 100
- Visualization: Query Value
- Alert threshold: > 1%
- Color: Red if > 1%, Yellow if > 0.5%

### Latency P95
- Metric: trace.request.duration.by.service.95percentile
- Visualization: Heatmap
- Group by: service, resource
- Alert threshold: > 1000ms

### Database Performance
- Metric: postgresql.queries.per.second
- Visualization: Timeseries
- Group by: database, query_type

### Infrastructure Metrics
- CPU Usage: system.cpu.usage
- Memory Usage: system.mem.used / system.mem.total * 100
- Disk I/O: system.disk.io.read + system.disk.io.write

## Alerts

### High Error Rate
Trigger: error_rate > 1% for 5 minutes
Notify: @slack-engineering, @pagerduty-oncall

### Slow Response Time
Trigger: p95_latency > 2000ms for 10 minutes
Notify: @slack-performance

### Service Down
Trigger: requests.per.second == 0 for 2 minutes
Notify: @pagerduty-oncall (Critical)

# PagerDuty Escalation Policy

## Level 1: On-Call Engineer (Immediate)
- Notification: Push, SMS, Phone Call
- Escalation after: 5 minutes

## Level 2: Team Lead (5 minutes)
- Notification: Push, SMS, Phone Call
- Escalation after: 10 minutes

## Level 3: Engineering Manager (15 minutes)
- Notification: Push, SMS, Phone Call
- Escalation after: 15 minutes

## Level 4: VP of Engineering (30 minutes)
- Notification: Phone Call

## Severity Levels

### P0 - Critical
- Complete system outage
- Data loss
- Security breach
- Response: Immediate
- Escalation: All levels

### P1 - High
- Major feature down
- Severe performance degradation
- Response: 15 minutes
- Escalation: Level 1-2

### P2 - Medium
- Minor feature issues
- Moderate performance issues
- Response: 1 hour
- Escalation: Level 1 only

### P3 - Low
- Cosmetic issues
- Minor bugs
- Response: Next business day
- Escalation: None

## Integration with DataDog

DataDog Monitor → PagerDuty Event
- Trigger: Monitor alert state
- Action: Create PagerDuty incident
- Priority: Based on severity
- Assign: On-call engineer
- Include: Runbook link, metrics snapshot
